title: Refining constant vector-space quotients into rank-one prime quotients
statement: Let X be a scheme and F(0),...,F(n) abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], with F(0) zero. Suppose each consecutive pair is identified with the first and second terms of a short exact complex whose third term is isomorphic to a finite iterated binary direct sum of a constant Z/ell sheaf [def-sc-constant-sheaves], for some prime ell depending on the step. Then there are m and sheaves G(a) for natural a, with G(0) zero, successive short exact complexes for a<m with rank-one prime constant third terms, and an isomorphism F(n) to G(m). Length-zero chains and zero-dimensional vector quotients are allowed.

proof.text: Let P be the isomorphism-closed property of being prime constant. Induct on d to put the d-fold binary sum of a prime constant in P.filtrationClosure: use the zero constructor and prop_biprod with le_filtrationClosure.

Induct on the coarse chain, transporting through its isomorphisms and using closure of P.filtrationClosure under extensions. Its endpoint belongs to P.filtrationClosure. The proved instance in WeilConjectures.Mathlib.CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.Extensions supplies IsClosedUnderExtensions; prop_X₂_of_shortExact is applied with the two endpoint isomorphisms.

Use the proved source-library filtrationClosure_iff to obtain a finite chain of monomorphisms with prime constant cokernels. Form canonical short exact complexes. Extend the chain constantly beyond the endpoint by min(a,m) and transport the endpoint isomorphism. Here filtrationClosure_iff is the proved upstream declaration in WeilConjectures.Mathlib.CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.Extensions, not an additional open claim.
